title: Recurring out-of-memory kills with no recent change
briefing:
You are paged at 05:10 UTC. The inventory-sync pods have been killed for running out of memory about every 40 minutes since 03:00 UTC.
- No deployment in the last 9 days. Heap usage grows linearly between kills.
- Each kill causes about 3 minutes without stock updates, so stale stock is shown and 12 hot items risk being oversold.
- Options available now: double the memory limit temporarily, schedule restarts every 30 minutes, or scale replicas.
- A heap dump or profile can be captured from a running pod; once a pod is killed, that state is lost.
- It is early morning; traffic is low but a promotion starts at 09:00 UTC.
safety_item: Chooses a stabilizing mitigation (for example a larger memory limit or scheduled restarts) while preserving diagnostic evidence such as a heap dump or profile for the later root-cause work.
